quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on the difficulty of guarding Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: He's 7'7 and can play like a guard. He's standing right here and dunk the ball without jumping.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: You have had to guard Victor Wembanyama before. What do you think is the key to stopping him in the finals for the Knicks?

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: I don't think there is an answer. I think you have to live with what he does. He is a human though. He is 7'7 and can play like a guard. He is standing right here and dunk the ball without jumping. What are you going to do about that?

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on the Knicks' playoff outlook against Mitchell Robinson and Clint Capela
quotes.excerpt: Cat and Mitchell Robinson got a long series ahead of them.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: Who do you have in the series?

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: I think this will slow down everybody else, all the other guards, and let him do his thing. They got a chance, but Cat and Mitchell Robinson got a long series ahead of them.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on the Philadelphia 76ers' team health and potential
quotes.excerpt: I think health is our biggest thing though.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: The 76ers have a good team though.

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: We have a good team. I think health is our biggest thing though.
